title: Task-Level Generative AI Adoption
discussion_signal: The post emphasizes the difference between occupational exposure and actual task-level use: generative AI reaches many occupations and tasks, but adoption within comparable work remains shallow. It directs readers toward the task-level table rather than treating broad exposure as realized automation.
linked_research_question: How far does broad AI exposure translate into repeated use within workers' actual tasks, and where does the exposure-to-adoption gap remain?
limits: Post is a secondary relay with compressed statistics
Broad task exposure is not equivalent to productivity, substitution, or job loss
